licence.name: driver’s licence (motor vehicle of a gross vehicle mass not exceeding 3,500 kg)

note: Read 2026-10-31 in archive.org's snapshot of 3 October 2023 of MalawiLII's PDF of the Road Traffic Act (Chapter 69:01, Act 26 of 1997), as at 31 December 2014, reproduced from the Government Gazette (MalawiLII's live pages answer this egress with a Cloudflare challenge). Section 19(1): a driving licence is issued by the Director (the Director of Road Traffic, s. 3); s. 21(1)(a)(ii): a person under eighteen is disqualified from a licence for a motor vehicle of a gross vehicle mass not exceeding 3,500 kg; s. 20: the licence's categories, its period of validity and its form are as prescribed. The term and the fee are null: they are prescribed by regulations, and the in-force fee regulations weren't found (the Ministry's list holds a 2019 draft; the DRTSS site's 2021 service-fee page and its 2024 React bundle, both archive snapshots read, give no licence fee or term). The 2014 consolidation is the latest MalawiLII text archived; no later amendment of s. 21 was looked for beyond it.

sources.title: Road Traffic Act (Chapter 69:01), MalawiLII, legislation as at 31 December 2014 (archive.org snapshot of 3 October 2023)
sources.said: Legislation as at 31 December 2014 ... A licence authorizing the driving of a motor vehicle shall be issued by the Director ... the period of validity of such licence ... is under the age of eighteen years
